description.value: Skidegate Inlet Retreat is a Haida-owned-and-operated property in Queen Charlotte on Graham Island, offering two self-contained suites — the Eagle Suite (sleeps 6) and the Raven Suite (sleeps 4) — with panoramic views over Skidegate Inlet and authentic Indigenous art throughout. The retreat sits on a hillside between the inlet and cedar forests, within walking distance of the marina, restaurants, and the farmers market, making it a comfortable base for exploring Haida Gwaii by bicycle. Host Robert is available to help guests connect with local adventure operators and cultural sites including the Ḵay Llnagaay Heritage Centre.
